snippet.title: EMUUROM trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
Document an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Study the behaviour of the EMUUROM creatures and use the gained knowledge to create new paths forward. Slowly, the machinations of the mythic forest sprites begin to unfold.

EMUUROM, from borbware, will release later in 2025.

EMUUROM in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/emuurom/

EMUUROM on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1634360/EMUUROM/

https://thinkgames.com/direct/
